files.skills/demo/SKILL.md:
---
name: demo
description: >-
  Count the open items in a task list. Use when the user asks to "count tasks", "count open items", "how many tasks", "tally the list", or "open item total". Do NOT use for editing tasks.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# demo

1. Run `python3 scripts/count.py <file>` to count the open items in the task list file.
2. Report the count.

Make sure that you always remember to carefully report the count of open items to the user in a single short sentence that names the file and then stop without doing any other work on the file or the list.
files.skills/demo/scripts/count.py:
import sys
print(sum(line.startswith('- [ ]') for line in open(sys.argv[1])))

cases.request: Run $skillz wedge skills/demo. Write the brief to brief.md. Write no other file.

files.skills/demo/SKILL.md:
---
name: demo
description: >-
  Summarize a task list. Use when the user asks to "summarize tasks", "review the task list", "who owns what", "task summary", or "open items by owner".
---

# demo

1. Count the open items: read the file and tally every line that starts with `- [ ]`.
2. Sort the tally by owner, then by item name.
3. Decide with the user which owner needs follow-up.
